movie:296271.overview: A powerful biotech company has breakthrough technology allowing them to clone history’s most influential people with just a few fragments of DNA. The Archangel Michael comes to earth and will stop at nothing to end the devil’s conspiracy.

It's the oddly relatable and interesting story that is the life of cells!
